'''Esral'sa'Nikto''', or '''Mountain Nikto''', were a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] adapted to the variable climate of the [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species" /> They had large facial fins which were used for heat regulation. These fins also improved the Esral'sa'Nikto's hearing. Their skin was [[Color/Legends|blue-gray]], and they had neither horns nor breathing tubes, though they did have a covered nose similar to the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]].
